table.retrieve:
SELECt aliasname=item.customicode,
			itemname= dbo.item.name, 
			dailycounter=purledger.dailycounter,
			monthlycounter=purledger.monthlycounter,
			monthofinv=datename(mm,date),
			dbo.itempacking.name,
			 itemcatname=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=purledger.icatcode),
			item_itemcategory=(select name from itemcategory where itemcategory.icatcode=item.icatcode),
			username=(select username from users where users.usercode=purledger.salesmancode),
			saleprice =  
				(Case When ((dbo.purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=8)OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=3)) then 
					 purdetail.salepriceforitem/purdetail.packunits
 				ELSE purdetail.salepriceforitem END) ,
			dbo.purledger.purinvcode,   
			dbo.purledger.date ,
			dbo.purledger.posted,  
			dbo.purledger.discperc,  
			dbo.purledger.advancetaxamt,  
			dbo.purledger.misccharges,  
			dbo.purledger.flatdisc,  
			dbo.purledger.salestax,  
			dbo.purledger.suppcode,  
			dbo.purdetail.icode,  
			dbo.purdetail.batch,  
			dbo.purdetail.expiry,
			qty = dbo.purdetail.packqty + dbo.purdetail.looseqty,  			
			dbo.purdetail.bonusqty, 
			dbo.purdetail.packunits,
			basicpackunits = dbo.purdetail.packunits, 
 
			dbo.purdetail.purprice,
			netrate=purdetail.netrate, 
			flatdiscforitem=dbo.purdetail.flatdiscforitem,
			salediscperc=item.salediscperc,
 
			dbo.purdetail.avgprice,    
			dbo.purdetail.discperc,
   		dbo.purdetail.IDENTITYCOL,
			dbo.purdetail.gstperc,
			dbo.purdetail.unitsalestax,
			dbo.purledger.invgstperc1,
			packcurrstock= CAST ( (case when posted='N' Then  (select sum(currqty) from godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = item.icode)
						  else
								purdetail.currstock
						  end) / purdetail.packunits AS INT),
			loosecurrstock=
				case when posted='N' Then  
						(select sum(currqty) from godowndetail 
						where godowndetail.icode = item.icode)
					else purdetail.currstock
					end -
				(Cast(case when posted='N' Then  
						(select sum(currqty) from godowndetail 
						where godowndetail.icode = item.icode)
					else purdetail.currstock
					end / purdetail.packunits AS INT) * purdetail.packunits),
			stock=(case when posted='N' Then  (select sum(currqty) from godowndetail where godowndetail.icode = item.icode)
						  else
								purdetail.currstock
						  end),
			SupplierName=LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.accounts.name)) + ' (' + LTRIM(RTRIM(dbo.accounts.acccode)) + ')',
			purcategory= case when purcatcode=1   THEN   'Normal Purchase Cash'
                         	when purcatcode=2   THEn   'Normal Purchase Credit' 
									when purcatcode=3   THEn   'Opening Purchase'
									when purcatcode=7   THEn   'Loose Purcahse cash' 
								   When purcatcode=8   THEn   'Loose Purcahse Credit'   
							END    , 
			catcode=purledger.purcatcode,                              
         dbo.purledger.remarks,
			currqty = Round(IsNull((Select  sum(currqty) 	
									from godowndetail 	
									where dbo.item.icode = godowndetail.icode),0)/ CONVERT(float,(dbo.purdetail.packunits)),2), 
			saleqty = Round(IsNull((Select Sum(dbo.saledetail.looseqty)/3
									FROM  dbo.saleledger,	 
											dbo.saledetail
									
									WHERE dbo.saleledger.date >= DateAdd(dd,-90,dbo.purledger.date) and 	
											dbo.saleledger.date <= dbo.purledger.date and 	
											dbo.saleledger.salecatcode IN (1, 2, 3) and	 
											dbo.saleledger.saleinvcode = dbo.saledetail.saleinvcode and	   
											dbo.saledetail.icode = dbo.item.icode  ), 0 ) / CONVERT(float,(dbo.purdetail.packunits)),2) ,
	/*19/11/02margin=((Case  When ((dbo.purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=8)) then (case when purledger.posted='N' then  (Round(item.saleprice/item.packunits,2))  else (Round(purdetail.saleprice/purdetail.packunits,2))end )
 					  ELSE    (case when purledger.posted='Y' then purdetail.saleprice  else item.saleprice end)
					  END) - ((((purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty) * purdetail.purprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (   purdetail.discperc * .01 )  ) )  * (1 - (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + ((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty)*unitsalestax )   ) / ( purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty)) * 100 / (Case  When ((dbo.purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=8)) then (case when purledger.posted='Y' then Round(purdetail.saleprice/purdetail.packunits,2) else Round(item.saleprice/item.packunits,2) end)
					  ELSE   (case when purledger.posted='Y' then   purdetail.saleprice  else item.saleprice end)
					  END)	,*/
/*last margin=((Case  When ((dbo.purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=8)) then (case when purledger.posted='N' then  (Round(item.saleprice/item.packunits,2))  else (Round(purdetail.saleprice/purdetail.packunits,2))end )
 					  ELSE    (case when purledger.posted='Y' then purdetail.saleprice  else item.saleprice end)
			+		  END) - (((((purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty) * purdetail.purprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (   purdetail.discperc * .01 )  ) )  * (1 - (.01 * purledger.discperc)) + ((purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.packqty + purdetail.bonusqty)*unitsalestax )  ) / ( purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty)) + Round( Round(purdetail.purprice * (1 - purdetail.discperc*0.01),2) * purdetail.gstperc * 0.01 , 2)  +  Round( (Round(purdetail.purprice * (1 - purdetail.discperc*0.01),2) * (1 - purledger.discperc * 0.01)) * purledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01 , 2)) * 100 / (Case  When ((dbo.purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=8)) then (case when purledger.posted='Y' then Round(purdetail.saleprice/purdetail.packunits,2) else Round(item.saleprice/item.packunits,2) end)
					  ELSE   (case when purledger.posted='Y' then   purdetail.saleprice  else item.saleprice end)
					  END),*/
	/*	nmargin=(((Case  When ((dbo.purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=8)) then (item.saleprice/item.packunits) +  (item.packsalestax/item.packunits)
 					  ELSE     item.saleprice  + item.packsalestax
					  END) - ((((purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty) * purdetail.purprice  )  *  ( 1 -  (   purdetail.discperc * .01 )  ) )  * (1 - (.01 * purledger.discperc))       ) / ( purdetail.packqty + purdetail.looseqty + purdetail.bonusqty)) + ( purdetail.unitsalestax + (purdetail.purprice * ( 1 - purdetail.discperc * 0.01)) * ( purledger.invgstperc1 * 0.01) )) * 100 / (Case  When ((dbo.purledger.purcatcode=7) OR (dbo.purledger.purcatcode=8)) then item.saleprice/item.packunits + item.packsalestax/item.packunits
					  ELSE     item.saleprice + item.packsalestax
					  END)	,*/
			porb=purledger.porb	,
			purtype=purchasetype.name,
			dbo.purledger.suppinvcode,
			dbo.purledger.suppinvdate,
			dbo.purledger.GRN,
			purcategory= case when purcatcode IN (1,2)   THEN   '(Pack)'
                         	when purcatcode=3   THEn   '(Opening)'
									when purcatcode IN (7,8)   THEn   '(Loose)' 
								  
							END       
			
	FROM
		dbo.purledger LEFT OUTER JOIN purchasetype ON (purledger.purtypecode = purchasetype.purtypecode), 
		dbo.item LEFT OUTER JOIN ItemPacking ON (dbo.item.packcode = dbo.itempacking.packcode),
		dbo.purdetail,
		dbo.accounts
			
   WHERE	( ( dbo.purledger.purinvcode = :ra_InvCode ) ) and 
			( dbo.purledger.purinvcode = dbo.purdetail.purinvcode ) and 
			(dbo.purledger.suppcode = dbo.accounts.acccode) and 
			( purdetail.icode = item.icode )          
order by item_itemcategory,
			itemname

objects.name: compute_3
objects.expression: Round((Round(sum( round(c_amount,2)  for all ) * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)

objects.name: c_totaltaxval
objects.expression: round(Round((Round(sum( round(c_amount,2)  for all ) * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)  + sum (c_salestaxval for all),f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_sumtaxval
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(( bonusqty  +  qty ) * unitsalestax  + Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) for all)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(( bonusqty  +  qty ) * unitsalestax  + Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) for all)

objects.name: compute_9
objects.expression: sum((c_amount *  ( 1 -   purledger_discperc * .01 )  + (unitsalestax * ( qty  +  bonusqty )) +  Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) +( Round((Round( round(c_amount,2)   * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)) )/ (qty + bonusqty) for all)

objects.name: c_nettotal
objects.expression: Round(Sum (  c_netamount for all ) -   purledger_flatdisc +   purledger_misccharges +  purledger_salestax, f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon')) + Round(Round((Round(sum( round(c_amount,2)  for all ) * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)  + sum (c_salestaxval for all), f_NumberPreferences('roundpurinvon'))

objects.name: c_itemnetamount
objects.expression: (c_amount *  ( 1 -   purledger_discperc * .01 )  + (unitsalestax * ( qty  +  bonusqty )) +  Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) +( Round((Round( round(c_amount,2)   * (1 -  purledger_discperc * 0.01),2)  -  purledger_flatdisc ) * 0.01 *  invgstperc1 ,2)) )/ (qty + bonusqty)

objects.name: c_salestaxval
objects.expression: ( bonusqty  +  qty ) * unitsalestax  + Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 )

objects.name: c_margin
objects.expression: Round ( (( (saleprice - flatdiscforitem * (1 - salediscperc * 0.01)) - ((netrate / if(packunits <= 0, 1, packunits)) *  basicpackunits)) / if(((netrate / if(packunits <= 0, 1, packunits)) *  basicpackunits) = 0, 1, ((netrate / if(packunits <= 0, 1, packunits)) *  basicpackunits)) ) * 100 , 2 )

objects.name: c_group_itemamt
objects.expression: sum(( qty  *  purprice   )  *  (1 -   ( purdetail_discperc * .01   ) ) for group 1)

objects.name: compute_17
objects.visible: 1	if(sum(( bonusqty  +  qty ) * unitsalestax  + Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) for group 1)=0,0,1)
objects.expression: sum(( bonusqty  +  qty ) * unitsalestax  + Round( c_amount  * 0.01 *   gstperc  , 2 ) for group 1)
